evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, santi adhicittam'anuyuttassa bhikkhuno oḷārikā upakkilesā kāyaduccaritaṃ vacīduccaritaṃ manoduccaritaṃ

21169.meaning1: who has the quality of unethical physical conduct; who physically misbehaves
21169.commentary: (MNa) kāyaduccaritasamaṅgī'ti-ādīsu samaṅgī'ti pañcavidhā samaṅgitā āyūhanasamaṅgitā cetanāsamaṅgitā kammasamaṅgitā vipākasamaṅgitā, upaṭṭhānasamaṅgitā'ti.

examples.text: aṭṭhānam'etaṃ anavakāso yaṃ kāyaduccaritasamaṅgī taṃnidānā tappaccayā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjeyya, n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatī'ti pajānāti

21170.meaning2: free from the 'smoke' of bad physical conduct, etc.

examples.text: idh'ānanda, bhikkhu upadhivivekā akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānā sabbaso kāyaduṭṭhullānaṃ paṭippassaddhiyā vivicc'eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.

21172.meaning1: faults of the body; defects of physical conduct

examples.text: eta'r'ahi kho pan'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, arahaṃ sammāsambuddho kusalo kāyavaṅkānaṃ kāyadosānaṃ kāyakasāvānaṃ, kusalo vacīvaṅkānaṃ vacīdosānaṃ vacīkasāvānaṃ, kusalo manovaṅkānaṃ manodosānaṃ manokasāvānaṃ.

idāni tīsu'pi dvāresu āyūhanacetanā samodhānetabbā. seyyath'idaṃ, kāyadvāre sayaṃkatamūlikā vīsati cetanā, āṇattimūlikā vīsati, sampajānamūlikā vīsati, asampajānamūlikā vīsatī'ti asīti cetanā honti, tathā vacīdvāre.

21175.synonym: kaḷebara, kaḷevara, gahaka, deha, bhastā, sandeha, samussaya, sarīra

examples.text: aṭṭhārasa kho imā, ānanda, dhātuyo, cakkhudhātu, rūpadhātu, cakkhuviññāṇadhātu, sotadhātu, saddadhātu, sotaviññāṇadhātu, ghānadhātu, gandhadhātu, ghānaviññāṇadhātu, jivhādhātu, rasadhātu, jivhāviññāṇadhātu, kāyadhātu, phoṭṭhabbadhātu, kāyaviññāṇadhātu, manodhātu, dhammadhātu, manoviññāṇadhātu.
evañ'hi te, gahapati, sikkhitabbaṃ. tasmā't'iha te, gahapati, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, na kāyaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me kāyanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī'ti. evañ'hi te, gahapati, sikkhitabbaṃ.

21178.meaning1: with what here?; with what now?
21178.commentary: (MNa) kāya nutthā'ti katamāya nu kathāya sannisinnā bhavathā'ti attho. kāya netthā'ti'pi pāḷi, tassā katamāya nu etthā'ti attho. kāya no'tthā'ti'pi pāḷi, tassā'pi purimo'y'eva attho.

examples.text: nisajja kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi, kāyanu'ttha, bhikkhave, eta'r'ahi kathāya sannisinnā?

21179.meaning1: ending with the body; limited to the body

21180.meaning1: conforming to the body; subject to the body; subservient to the body

examples.text: tassa kho etaṃ, bho gotama, kāy'anvayaṃ cittaṃ hoti, kāyassa vasena vattati. taṃ kissa hetu? abhāvitattā cittassa.

21181.meaning1: subservience to the body; (comm) defilments connected to the body
21181.meaning2: fact of conforming to the body; fact of being subject to the body
21181.meaningLit: fact of conforming to the body
21181.commentary: (MNa) kāy'anvayatā'ti kāy'ānugamanabhāvo, kāyaṃ anugacchanakakileso'ti attho. (MNt) eso'ham'asmi, eso me attā'ti-ādinā (ma. ni. 1.241, saṃ. ni. 3.8) kāyaṃ anvetī'ti kāy'anvayo, so'y'eva, tassa vā samūho kāy'anvayatā, kāyapaṭibaddho kileso.

examples.text: tass'imaṃ kāyaṃ aniccato dukkhato rogato gaṇḍato sallato aghato ābādhato parato palokato suññato anattato samanupassato yo kāyasmiṃ kāyachando kāyasneho kāy'anvayatā sā pahīyati.

21182.meaning1: connected to the body; touching the body

examples.text: dinnaṃ nāma kāyena vā kāyapaṭibaddhena vā nissaggiyena vā dente hatthapāse ṭhito kāyena vā kāyapaṭibaddhena vā paṭiggaṇhāti, etaṃ dinnaṃ nāma.
pahāraṃ dadeyyā'ti kāyena vā kāyapaṭibaddhena vā nissaggiyena vā antamaso uppalapattena'pi pahāraṃ deti, āpatti pācittiyassa.

21184.meaning1: limited to the body; confined to the body

21185.meaning1: limited to the body; physically circumscribed
21185.commentary: (ANa) kāyapariyantikan'ti kāy'antikaṃ kāyaparicchinnaṃ, yāva pañcadvārakāyo pavattati, tāva pavattaṃ pañcadvārikavedanan'ti attho.

examples.text: so kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamāno kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmī'ti pajānāti, jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamāno jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmī'ti pajānāti

21186.meaning1: for the purpose of taking care of the body

21187.meaning1: for looking after the body; for taking care of the body

examples.text: so santuṭṭho hoti kāyaparihārikena cīvarena kucchiparihārikena piṇḍapātena so yena yen'eva pakkamati samādāy'eva pakkamati

21190.meaning1: based on the sense of touch

21191.meaning1: physical calmness; bodily tranquillity; (comm) stilling of distress in the three aggregates of feeling, perception and thinking

examples.text: atthi, bhikkhave, kāyapassaddhi, cittapassaddhi. tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro, ayam'āhāro anuppannassa vā passaddhisambojjh'aṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā passaddhisambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.

21193.meaning1: physical agitation; physical irritation; physical disturbance; (comm) physical wrongdoing

examples.text: kāyappakopaṃ rakkheyya, kāyena saṃvuto siyā, kāyaduccaritaṃ hitvā, kāyena sucaritaṃ care.

21196.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of kāyappacālaka
21196.meaning1: swinging the body; swaggering; swaying the body

examples.text: na kāyappacālakaṃ antaraghare gamissāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū kāyappacālakaṃ antaraghare gacchanti kāyaṃ olambentā

21197.meaning1: dependent on the body; connected to the body
21197.commentary: (MNa) kāyappaṭibaddhā'ti kāyanissitā, kāye sati honti, asati na honti.

examples.text: assāsapassāsā kho, gahapati, kāyikā. ete dhammā kāyappaṭibaddhā, tasmā assāsapassāsā kāyasaṅkhāro.

21198.meaning1: attached to the body; adhering to the body
21198.commentary: (SNa) tassa vissajjane kāyappaṭibaddhā'ti kāyanissitā. kāye sati honti, asati na honti.

examples.text: assāsapassāsā kho, gahapati, kāyikā. ete dhammā kāyappaṭibaddhā, tasmā assāsapassāsā kāyasaṅkhāro. pubbe kho, gahapati, vitakketvā vicāretvā pacchā vācaṃ bhindati, tasmā vitakkavicārā vacīsaṅkhāro.

21199.meaning1: fact of being connected to the body
